class.name: FellowFaceAnimator
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: a face that speaks and blinks — its mouth's blend shapes from the voice it plays (analysed as it plays, ahead of the sound), its eyes blinking at random.
class.description: A child anywhere under the character: set [member mesh_path] to the face's [MeshInstance3D] (its mesh with blend shapes; ARKit's names by default, see [member blend_shapes]) and [member voice_path] to the player of its voice ([AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D]). While the player plays, the stream is analysed a little ahead of its position (its playback rendered offline once and shared by every face playing it: the level and five bands' energies every 10 ms) into the mouth's channels — [constant CHANNEL_JAW_OPEN] with an open vowel's high first formant, [constant CHANNEL_MOUTH_WIDE] with a front vowel's high second formant, [constant CHANNEL_MOUTH_ROUND] with a back vowel's low one, [constant CHANNEL_TEETH] with the hiss of s and f, [constant CHANNEL_MOUTH_CLOSED] as it falls silent — read [member anticipation] ahead of what is heard, eased ([member attack], [member release]) and set on the blend shapes. A timeline can drive it instead: [member voice_stream] read at [member voice_time] (an [AnimationPlayer]'s track setting it). The eyes blink between [member blink_interval_min] and [member blink_interval_max] seconds apart, and look at [member look_target_path] with small saccades (milestone 89; ARKit's [code]eyeLook*[/code] shapes). Language-independent and without phonemes: a stylised mouth, not a speech recogniser's visemes. See [code]docs/decisions/0191-face-animation.md[/code]. Expressions (milestone 100): [method set_expression] fades named sets of channels — the brows, the mouth's corners, the cheeks, the eyes' squint and widening, the nose — in and out on top of the rest (six built in after FACS, and [member expressions]); the voice's stressed syllables raise the brows ([member speech_brows]) and emit [signal emphasized].

method.name: blink
method.description: Blinks now (unless a blink is under way).

method.name: clear_analysis_cache
method.description: Forgets every voice's analysis (analysed again when played again). The cache keeps at most 256 voices.

method.name: clear_expressions
method.description: Fades every expression out over [param fade] seconds (0: at once) (milestone 100).

method.name: get_channel
method.description: A channel's value now, 0 to 1 (as set on the blend shapes).

method.name: get_channels
method.description: Every channel's value now, by name.

method.name: get_emphasis
method.description: The brows' pulse from the voice's last stressed syllable: 1 at it, fading over 0.3 s (milestone 100).

method.name: get_expression_names
method.description: The expressions [method set_expression] knows: the built-in ones ([code]happy[/code], [code]sad[/code], [code]angry[/code], [code]surprised[/code], [code]afraid[/code], [code]disgusted[/code]) and those in [member expressions].

method.name: get_expression_weight
method.description: How much of an expression the face shows now (0 to 1, as it fades).

method.name: get_gaze_angles
method.description: The gaze now, in degrees: x to the character's left, y up (eased; saccades in).

method.name: get_vergence
method.description: How far each eye turns in now, in degrees ([member eye_spacing]; eased).

method.name: reset_global_stats
method.description: Sets the counts of [method get_global_stats] to zero.

method.name: sample_voice
method.description: The mouth's channels the analysis gives at [param time] seconds into [param stream] (unsmoothed), with the level ([code]level_db[/code]) and the scores they came from ([code]open_score[/code], [code]wide_score[/code], [code]low_score[/code], [code]hiss_score[/code], in dB), [code]analysed_seconds[/code] and [code]analysis_usec[/code].

method.name: set_expression
method.description: Fades an expression to [param weight] over [param fade] seconds (0: at once) (milestone 100). Expressions add up — each channel at most 1 — on top of the lip sync, the blinks and the gaze: [code]set_expression(&"happy")[/code] smiles; [code]set_expression(&"happy", 0.0, 0.5)[/code] with [code]set_expression(&"sad", 1.0, 0.5)[/code] crossfades. The built-in ones follow the action units Ekman and Friesen give for the basic emotions (FACS): [code]happy[/code] (the cheeks raised, the corners pulled), [code]sad[/code] (the inner brows raised and drawn, the corners down), [code]angry[/code] (the brows down, the lids tightened, the lips pressed), [code]surprised[/code] (the brows up, the eyes wide, the jaw dropped), [code]afraid[/code], [code]disgusted[/code] (the nose wrinkled, the corners down); [member expressions] adds the game's own or changes these.

members.member: How far ahead of what is heard the mouth reads the voice, in seconds: a mouth moves before its sound.
The time constant of a channel rising, in seconds.

member.name: blend_shapes
member.default: { "blink_left": PackedStringArray("eyeBlinkLeft"), "blink_right": PackedStringArray("eyeBlinkRight"), "brow_down_left": PackedStringArray("browDownLeft"), "brow_down_right": PackedStringArray("browDownRight"), "brow_inner_up": PackedStringArray("browInnerUp"), "brow_outer_up_left": PackedStringArray("browOuterUpLeft"), "brow_outer_up_right": PackedStringArray("browOuterUpRight"), "cheek_squint_left": PackedStringArray("cheekSquintLeft"), "cheek_squint_right": PackedStringArray("cheekSquintRight"), "eye_squint_left": PackedStringArray("eyeSquintLeft"), "eye_squint_right": PackedStringArray("eyeSquintRight"), "eye_wide_left": PackedStringArray("eyeWideLeft"), "eye_wide_right": PackedStringArray("eyeWideRight"), "frown_left": PackedStringArray("mouthFrownLeft"), "frown_right": PackedStringArray("mouthFrownRight"), "jaw_open": PackedStringArray("jawOpen"), "look_down_left": PackedStringArray("eyeLookDownLeft"), "look_down_right": PackedStringArray("eyeLookDownRight"), "look_in_left": PackedStringArray("eyeLookInLeft"), "look_in_right": PackedStringArray("eyeLookInRight"), "look_out_left": PackedStringArray("eyeLookOutLeft"), "look_out_right": PackedStringArray("eyeLookOutRight"), "look_up_left": PackedStringArray("eyeLookUpLeft"), "look_up_right": PackedStringArray("eyeLookUpRight"), "mouth_closed": PackedStringArray(), "mouth_round": PackedStringArray("mouthPucker", "mouthFunnel"), "mouth_wide": PackedStringArray("mouthStretchLeft", "mouthStretchRight"), "nose_sneer_left": PackedStringArray("noseSneerLeft"), "nose_sneer_right": PackedStringArray("noseSneerRight"), "smile_left": PackedStringArray("mouthSmileLeft"), "smile_right": PackedStringArray("mouthSmileRight"), "teeth": PackedStringArray("mouthRollLower") }

members.member: Which blend shapes each channel moves: a channel's name ([code]jaw_open[/code], [code]mouth_wide[/code], [code]mouth_round[/code], [code]mouth_closed[/code], [code]teeth[/code], [code]blink_left[/code], [code]blink_right[/code], [code]look_out_left[/code], [code]look_in_left[/code], [code]look_up_left[/code], [code]look_down_left[/code] and the same [code]_right[/code]) and a blend shape's name or a [PackedStringArray] of them. A blend shape moved by several channels gets their sum (at most 1). By default ARKit's: [code]jawOpen[/code]; [code]mouthStretchLeft[/code], [code]mouthStretchRight[/code]; [code]mouthPucker[/code], [code]mouthFunnel[/code]; none; [code]mouthRollLower[/code]; [code]eyeBlinkLeft[/code]; [code]eyeBlinkRight[/code]; [code]eyeLookOutLeft[/code], [code]eyeLookInLeft[/code], [code]eyeLookUpLeft[/code], [code]eyeLookDownLeft[/code] and the same [code]Right[/code].
A blink's length, in seconds: closing in a third of it, closed a sixth, opening in half.
The longest time between two blinks, in seconds.
The shortest time between two blinks, in seconds.
The eyes blink at random intervals.

The game's own expressions (milestone 100): a name and a [Dictionary] of channels' names (as in [member blend_shapes]) and their weights (−1 to 1): [code]{"wink": {"blink_left": 1.0, "smile_left": 0.3}}[/code]. A built-in name here replaces the built-in expression.
The point between the eyes, in the face mesh's space, the gaze's directions are measured from.

The distance between the eyes, in metres (milestone 94): each eye turns in by half the angle the target subtends between them, so the eyes converge on a near target (0.6 m away with 0.064 m: 3° each). 0: the eyes parallel.
The eyes look at [member look_target_path] (within [member gaze_range_horizontal] and [member gaze_range_vertical]), with [member saccades], through the eyeLook channels (milestone 89).
The eyes' reach left and right, in degrees: at it the look_out and look_in channels are 1 (beyond: clamped).
The eyes' reach up and down, in degrees.
The time constant of the eyes' turn, in seconds (a saccade is fast).
The voice's level (a sine's peak dB for its mean square over 20 ms) at which the mouth starts to move.
The voice's level at which the mouth's channels reach their full value.
The mouth follows the voice.
What the eyes look at ([Node3D]): its direction from [member eye_center] in the face mesh's space (the face looking along +Z, its left +X) gives the gaze's angles. Empty: ahead.
At most this much of a voice is analysed (a longer one is silent past it; a loop wraps when it was all analysed).
The face's [MeshInstance3D]: its blend shapes are set each frame (only those that changed).
The time constant of a channel falling, in seconds.
The saccades' reach, in degrees (vertically 0.6 of it).
Small quick eye movements at random intervals (0.4-1.6 s) round where they look.
The seed of the blinks' intervals.

How far the voice's stressed syllables raise the brows (milestone 100): where its level rises [member speech_emphasis_db] above its last half second's (a syllable after a pause, a stressed one), the inner brows rise by this much and the outer ones by 60 % of it, fading over 0.3 s; once a rise (a held vowel raises them once), at most every quarter second. 0: off. The signal [signal emphasized] marks each.
How much the voice's level must rise above its last half second's for a stressed syllable.
The mouth's channels times this (not [code]mouth_closed[/code]).

The player of the voice: [AudioStreamPlayer], [AudioStreamPlayer2D] or [AudioStreamPlayer3D]. Its stream is analysed as it plays, at its playback position (what is heard: the mix's position, the time since the mix and the output's latency; under Movie Maker the position).
With [member voice_time] 0 or more: the voice read at that time instead of a player's (a timeline drives the face).
Where in [member voice_stream] the mouth reads, in seconds (an animation track can set it); below 0: the player at [member voice_path] drives it.

signal.name: emphasized
signal.description: A stressed syllable of the voice where the mouth reads it (milestone 100): [param strength] 0.5 for a rise of [member speech_emphasis_db], 1 for twice that. A game can nod the head or gesture there.

constants.constant: The jaw open: with the voice's level, most for open vowels (a).
The mouth wide: front vowels (i, e).
The mouth round: back vowels (u, o).
The lips closed: 1 in silence (not mapped by default).
The lower lip under the teeth: the hiss of s, f, sh.
The left eye closed.
The right eye closed.
The left eye looking out (to the character's left).
The left eye looking in (to the character's right).
The left eye looking up.
The left eye looking down.
The right eye looking out (to the character's right).
The right eye looking in (to the character's left).
The right eye looking up.
The right eye looking down.
The inner brows raised (milestone 100).
The left brow lowered.
The right brow lowered.
The left brow's outer end raised.
The right brow's outer end raised.
The mouth's left corner pulled up.
The mouth's right corner pulled up.
The mouth's left corner pulled down.
The mouth's right corner pulled down.
The left cheek raised.
The right cheek raised.
The left eye's lids tightened.
The right eye's lids tightened.
The left eye widened.
The right eye widened.
The nose wrinkled on the left.
The nose wrinkled on the right.
The number of channels.
